name: explorer
about: Search the workspace from the explorer. The block list shows only blocks that carried operations among the last 100 (explorer/src/host.rs:22): a quiet network has none, and the explorer cannot make one, so inspecting a block is not walked here. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 explorer/src/presentation.rs:179 — every block row is named Inspect block: rows differ only by id or a child label
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 explorer — a search hit cannot be opened (it has only Copy reference)

ducktape-views@a2a73e1 explorer/src/presentation.rs:192-193 — the empty ledger says No blocks yet beside a header that says block 10,984: the list is the last 100 blocks that carried operations (FINDINGS-2026-09-19 E1)

steps.say: open the Explorer tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Explorer tab is selected and the explorer view shows a Search messages, pages, issues, files, runs… field, a Refresh button, and either block rows (buttons named Inspect block) or the empty ledger (No blocks yet, with a line saying blocks that carry operations appear here); no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: search the workspace: type qa and Enter into the search field
steps.expect: search results show: an All filter button with result rows, or 'No matching results.' (Searching… is a state, not an error)
